title: White as Snow
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about being made clean after getting it wrong, and Willow the Warm is the Traveler who goes back, says sorry out loud, and finds her heart light again.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she knows the gift of being made clean and new. In Willow’s world today: Willow said an unkind word to her friend and felt a heavy, yucky feeling inside. She went back, gave a hug, and said, “I’m sorry — that wasn’t kind.” Right away her heart felt light and clean, like fresh snow. Just like Heavenly Father’s promise to make our hearts white as snow, Willow found that saying sorry brings a clean, happy heart.
